name: SHErlock
overview:
"SHErlock" is the first all-female immersive mystery program on Mango TV, a Chinese mainland online platform. The six female guests, Qi Wei, Zhang Yuqi, Li Yitong, Li Xueqin, Tian Xiwei, and Zhang Yifan, form the women's mystery team.

It is the first female-centric "puzzle-solving" show. The show explores workplace issues faced by women, such as workplace PUA, sexual harassment, yin-yang contracts, etc. The show features a legal education segment with a lawyer expert at the end of each episode.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview:
The "Hao Hao Hao" Detective Agency receives a commission to investigate the disappearance of Cheng Lala. Since Cheng Lala was last seen at the "1111 New Media Company" on Sanban Island, six members of the agency—Qi Wei, Zhang Yuqi, Li Yitong, Li Xueqin, Tian Xiwei, and Zhang Yifan—disguise themselves as new employees. The investigation progresses through various smaller cases and a major case that spans the entire season.

Taking women' sensibility, empathy, gentleness, sensitivity and intelligence as the starting point, the series takes the audience through an immersive process of investigating the cases.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: As a continuation of the first season, all six members of the "Hao Hao Hao" Detective Agency have returned, transformed into hotel employees, immersed in workplace life, and performing new tasks.
